+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_TRANSCRIPTION_API = "https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/transcriptions"
+
+
+@dataclass
+class StreamingRecognitionResult:
+    text: str
+    is_final: bool
+    confidence: Optional[float] = None
+    raw: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
+
+
+def _coerce_bool(value: Any) -> bool:
+    if isinstance(value, bool):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        return value.strip().lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "final"}
+    return bool(value)
+
+
+def parse_partial_result(event: Dict[str, Any]) -> StreamingRecognitionResult:
+    text = str(event.get("text") or event.get("transcript") or event.get("alternative", {}).get("transcript") or "")
+    is_final = _coerce_bool(event.get("is_final", event.get("final", event.get("speech_final", False))))
+    confidence = event.get("confidence")
+    if confidence is None and isinstance(event.get("alternative"), dict):
+        confidence = event["alternative"].get("confidence")
+    try:
+        confidence = None if confidence is None else float(confidence)
+    except (TypeError, ValueError):
+        confidence = None
+    return StreamingRecognitionResult(text=text, is_final=is_final, confidence=confidence, raw=event)
+
+
+def handle_partial_and_final(event: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    result = parse_partial_result(event)
+    return {
+        "text": result.text,
+        "status": "final" if result.is_final else "partial",
+        "confidence": result.confidence,
+        "raw": result.raw,
+    }
+
+
+def send_to_openai_transcription(audio_bytes: bytes, filename: str = "audio.wav", model: str = "gpt-4o-mini-transcribe") -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    api_key = os.environ["OPENAI_API_KEY"]
+    files = {"file": (filename, audio_bytes)}
+    data = {"model": model, "response_format": "verbose_json"}
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_TRANSCRIPTION_API,
+        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}"},
+        files=files,
+        data=data,
+        timeout=60,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.json()
*** End Patch

+import asyncio
+from typing import AsyncIterable, AsyncIterator, Optional
+
+import aiohttp
+
+
+GOOGLE_CLOUD_SPEECH_V1_STREAMING_RECOGNIZE_URL = "https://speech.googleapis.com/v1/speech:recognize"
+
+
+async def stream_chunks(source: AsyncIterable[bytes], timeout: Optional[float] = None) -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
+    async for chunk in source:
+        if chunk:
+            yield chunk
+
+
+async def transcribe_google_stream(audio_source: AsyncIterable[bytes], api_key: str) -> str:
+    payload = {
+        "config": {
+            "encoding": "LINEAR16",
+            "languageCode": "en-US",
+            "model": "latest_long",
+            "enableAutomaticPunctuation": True,
+        },
+        "audio": {"content": ""},
+    }
+    buffered = bytearray()
+    async for chunk in stream_chunks(audio_source):
+        buffered.extend(chunk)
+    if buffered:
+        payload["audio"]["content"] = buffered.hex()
+
+    async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
+        async with session.post(
+            GOOGLE_CLOUD_SPEECH_V1_STREAMING_RECOGNIZE_URL,
+            params={"key": api_key},
+            json=payload,
+            timeout=timeout,
+        ) as response:
+            response.raise_for_status()
+            data = await response.json()
+    results = data.get("results", [])
+    if not results:
+        return ""
+    alternatives = results[0].get("alternatives", [])
+    if not alternatives:
+        return ""
+    return alternatives[0].get("transcript", "")
*** End Patch

+import asyncio
+import os
+from typing import AsyncIterator, Optional
+
+from google.cloud import speech
+
+
+def _audio_stream(record_seconds: float = 0.0) -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
+    try:
+        import pyaudio
+    except Exception as exc:
+        raise RuntimeError("pyaudio is required for microphone streaming") from exc
+
+    sample_rate = 16000
+    chunk_size = int(sample_rate / 10)
+    audio_format = pyaudio.paInt16
+    channels = 1
+
+    pa = pyaudio.PyAudio()
+    stream = pa.open(
+        format=audio_format,
+        channels=channels,
+        rate=sample_rate,
+        input=True,
+        frames_per_buffer=chunk_size,
+    )
+
+    async def generator() -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
+        start = asyncio.get_event_loop().time()
+        try:
+            while True:
+                if record_seconds > 0 and (asyncio.get_event_loop().time() - start) >= record_seconds:
+                    break
+                data = await asyncio.to_thread(stream.read, chunk_size, False)
+                yield data
+        finally:
+            stream.stop_stream()
+            stream.close()
+            pa.terminate()
+
+    return generator()
+
+
+async def stream_microphone(language_code: str = "en-US", punctuation: bool = True, record_seconds: float = 0.0) -> AsyncIterator[str]:
+    client = speech.SpeechAsyncClient()
+    config = speech.RecognitionConfig(
+        encoding=speech.RecognitionConfig.AudioEncoding.LINEAR16,
+        sample_rate_hertz=16000,
+        language_code=language_code,
+        enable_automatic_punctuation=punctuation,
+        model="latest_long",
+    )
+    streaming_config = speech.StreamingRecognitionConfig(
+        config=config,
+        interim_results=True,
+        single_utterance=False,
+    )
+
+    async def requests() -> AsyncIterator[speech.StreamingRecognizeRequest]:
+        async for chunk in _audio_stream(record_seconds=record_seconds):
+            yield speech.StreamingRecognizeRequest(audio_content=chunk)
+
+    responses = await client.streaming_recognize(streaming_config=streaming_config, requests=requests())
+    async for response in responses:
+        for result in response.results:
+            if result.alternatives:
+                yield result.alternatives[0].transcript
+
+
+__all__ = ["stream_microphone"]
*** End Patch
